description.value: Sunnyside Outdoor Pool is a seasonal municipal outdoor pool operated by the City of Surrey, offering free public swimming through the summer months. It also provides swimming lessons by phone registration. A refreshing stop for touring cyclists passing through South Surrey during the summer season.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the pool is open for free public swimming until September 7, 2026, confirming it is currently operating (seasonally). The address (15455 - 26 Avenue Surrey, BC) and phone (604-502-6255) on the website match the OSM record. No information about bike parking, water refill, washrooms, showers, or any cycling-specific amenities is mentioned on the website, so all required criteria and optional amenities are null. The OSM community tag says 'Tsawwassen' but the facility is operated by the City of Surrey and the website address says Surrey, BC.
concerns: OSM community is listed as 'Tsawwassen' but the facility is operated by the City of Surrey and the website address is in Surrey, BC — community assignment may be incorrect.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A free seasonal outdoor pool is a welcome stop for touring cyclists in summer. It is a legitimate, currently operating public recreation facility.
enrichment_extras.notes: Seasonal facility; open approximately mid-May through early September.
